content.comment_body: Good morning, I am working on setting up a [product_name] device to send notification emails when certain events happen. I successfully configured the SMTP parameters for a new mailbox and, after some effort, was able to send test emails. However, the automatic triggers in the program do not initiate email sending as expected, even when trying system triggers like stop/run or off/on.

Hi, There is a link to a download that includes a firmware update for [product_name] modules to [version_no]. The update description mentions improvements to the email function. Please check if [version_no] is installed on your device, and if not, update your [product_name] and try again. Hope this helps.
Here is the missing link: Firmware update for [product_name] devices and service pack for [product_name] [version_no].
I updated both the [product_name] firmware and [product_name] software to the latest version. Everything now works as expected. Thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced challenges activating automated email triggers with their [product_name] device, even though manual emails via SMTP worked. Updating both firmware and software resolved the issue, demonstrating that current firmware is crucial for reliable feature operation. This feedback emphasizes the importance of keeping automation products up to date for correct and dependable function.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that configuring notification triggers in the [product_name] system will allow emails to be sent automatically during defined events, without complex setup procedures.
